acceptedAnswer.text: On average, Texans pay $3143 annually for home insurance which is higher than the national average. Texas is an expensive state to buy home insurance due to a combination of natural and financial factors.

mainEntity.name: Why is business insurance important for companies in Houston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Business insurance is essential for companies in Houston because it helps protect businesses from potential financial losses that could occur as a result of damage or injuries sustained in the course of business operations.
